title: Make and use a simple lambda function
description: A lambda is a short function written in one line. Create a lambda that accepts a value and performs a simple operation, save it in a variable, then call it and print the result.
solution:

print(add(4, 5))

title: Use filter and lambda to keep matching values
description: Create a list of numbers. Use filter() with a lambda condition to keep only values you want, such as even numbers. Convert the result to a list and print it.
solution:
numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
evens = list(filter(lambda n: n % 2 == 0, numbers))
print(evens)

title: Use map and lambda to change every value in a list
description: Create a list of numbers. Use map() with a lambda to change each value, such as squaring every number. Convert the result to a list and print it.
solution:

squares = list(map(lambda n: n ** 2, numbers))
print(squares)
